Predicates.name: FiniteVerdict
Predicates.formula: =IF({{IsCached}}=1,{{FiniteVerdictCache}},IF({{InstanceCount}}=0,"NO INSTANCES",IF({{FailingCount}}=0,"HOLDS ON EVERY INSTANCE",IF({{FailureRefutes}}=1,CONCAT("REFUTED BY ",{{FailingCount}}," OF ",{{InstanceCount}}," INSTANCES"),CONCAT({{FailingCount}}," OF ",{{InstanceCount}}," UNDECIDED AT THE HORIZON")))))
